entities.summary: Iryna Mykolaivna Melnykova was a Soviet and Ukrainian historian of Czechoslovakia. Doctor of Historical Sciences. Corresponding Member of the National Academy of Sciences of Ukraine. Her research interests also include the political and economic history of Central and Eastern Europe, with a particular focus on the interwar period.
